# WHY A PANEL AND NOT ONE DECK. 30_parity.slurm asked the platform question of
# probe/Cr_lit3/oosh__1x1_off_magp__g1 -- which is one of the two rows the LIT-3
# GATE-1 review had already flagged BASIN_DRIFT (child 8.29 meV ABOVE its own
# parent, totmag 11.00 -> 14.90). Measuring parity against a drifted child
# measures the drift, not the platform. The panel re-asks it of the AGREE rows,
# which are spin-polarized and have a unique solution, and re-asks it of the
# drifted rows against BOTH their child and their parent.
